title: Hyperspace
description: A jump to light speed from one point: a thin ring draws in to a glint, star streaks start to pour out of it and accelerate, the glint pulls in for a held breath, then the streaks stretch to the frame edges and a white flash swallows the frame. Ends on the flash, so cut to the next shot there (a flash transition, an intro, a reveal).

origin.description: The vanishing point the streaks pour from, {x, y} from 0 to 1.

colors.description: Streak colours as #rrggbb, the first most common (empty: the ink, then the accent and secondary).

flash.description: What the jump ends in: a white flash, an accent-colour flash, or none (the streaks fade out).
